lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashfall Outpost. The distress call loops: the same words, the same pauses, the same cough.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: No life signs. No heat. Just the transmitter.

lines.speaker: mimic
lines.text: This is Warden Cole. Our hull is open. We have room for you.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Maybe they're down in the lower shafts, shielded.

lines.speaker: sparrow_pilot
lines.text: Contacts. Weave... I think? They look chewed.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: The translator is starting to catch words. About one in three.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Husks. Whatever hit Ashfall hurt them too. Let's finish it.
